name: Get All Projects
description: Gets metadata on all projects. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/#api-rest-api-3-project-get)

configurable_props.name: recent
configurable_props.label: Recent Projects
configurable_props.description: Returns the user's most recently accessed projects. You may specify the number of results to return up to a maximum of 20. If access is anonymous, then the recently accessed projects are based on the current HTTP session.

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: Details of issue properties to be added or updated. Please provide an array of objects with keys and values.

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description:
Use expand to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Expanded options include:
`description` Returns the project description.
`issueTypes` Returns all issue types associated with the project.
`lead` Returns information about the project lead.
`projectKeys` Returns all project keys associated with the project.
